user_stories.title: Create cre_case module skeleton with type definitions and documentation
acceptance_criteria: Module cre_case.erl exists in src/api/ directory
Module compiles without errors or warnings
All required types are exported: case_id, case_status, case_info, option, options
Module has comprehensive -moduledoc with overview and examples
Type definitions match the requirements from research
All exported function signatures are declared with -spec attributes
Documentation follows cre_client.erl pattern
user_stories.notes: Foundation for the entire public API. Must be completed before any implementation work.

user_stories.title: Implement start_case/3 and start_case/4 with option parsing
acceptance_criteria: start_case/3 accepts SpecId and InitialData, uses default options
start_case/4 accepts SpecId, InitialData, and Options list
Options are parsed with proplists:get_value using defaults: scheduler_policy=nondeterministic, step_quanta=1, trace_level=min, effect_handler=ln_effect, timeout=5000
Options are validated using validate_options internal function
Valid options are passed through to wf_case_sup:start_case/3
Returns {ok, CaseId} on success, {error, Reason} on failure
Function has comprehensive -doc with Parameters, Returns, Options, and Examples sections
Type specs are present and correct
user_stories.notes: Core function for creating workflow cases. Must properly parse and validate all required options.

user_stories.title: Implement case query functions (get_case_info, get_case_status, get_case_results, list_cases, find_case)
acceptance_criteria: get_case_info/1 returns sanitized #case_info{} record hiding internal fields
get_case_status/1 returns {ok, Status} where Status is case_status() atom
get_case_results/1 returns {ok, Results} map for completed cases, {error, not_completed} otherwise
list_cases/0 returns {ok, [CaseId]} list of all active case IDs
find_case/1 returns {ok, Pid} or {error, not_found}
All functions delegate to wf_case_sup and wf_case_runner
sanitize_case_info/1 removes internal fields like marking, rng_state
All functions have comprehensive documentation
Type specs are present for all functions
user_stories.notes: Query functions are read-only operations. Critical for monitoring and inspecting case state.

user_stories.title: Implement case control functions (suspend_case, resume_case, cancel_case)
acceptance_criteria: suspend_case/2 accepts CaseId and Reason, delegates to wf_engine:suspend_case/3
resume_case/2 accepts CaseId and Reason, delegates to wf_engine:resume_case/3
cancel_case/2 accepts CaseId and Reason, delegates to wf_engine:cancel_case/3
All functions return ok on success, {error, Reason} on failure
Functions have comprehensive documentation with examples
Type specs are present and correct
user_stories.notes: Case control functions enable lifecycle management. Required for production use cases.

user_stories.title: Implement work item query functions (get_worklist, get_workitem_info)
acceptance_criteria: get_worklist/2 accepts CaseId and UserId, returns {ok, [WorkItemMap]}
Work items are sanitized - internal record fields converted to maps
WorkItemMap contains: id, task_name, offered_to, status
get_workitem_info/2 accepts CaseId and WorkItemId, returns {ok, WorkItemMap}
Functions delegate to wf_engine:worklist/2
Functions have comprehensive documentation
Type specs are present
user_stories.notes: Read-only work item queries. Allocation operations (allocate, start, complete) are out of scope for this initial API.

user_stories.title: Add doctest_test/0 function and create example workflows
acceptance_criteria: doctest_test/0 function exists and tests option validation
doctest_test/0 tests sanitize_case_info logic
docs/examples/cre_case_example.erl file exists
basic_example/0 demonstrates start_case, get_case_status, list_cases, get_worklist, suspend_case, resume_case, cancel_case
options_example/0 demonstrates all four options: scheduler_policy, step_quanta, trace_level, effect_handler
Examples compile and run successfully in Erlang shell
Documentation can be generated with edoc
user_stories.notes: Examples and doctests are critical for user onboarding and documentation.
